caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic cup placed centrally against a plain background. The cup is rendered in shades of silver and gray, with hints of light blue and yellow reflecting on its surface to suggest its shiny, polished appearance. The cup has a simple, rounded form with no handle and a slight shadow underneath to indicate its placement on a flat surface. Engraved on the cup are the initials "R T". The background is a uniform beige color with a slightly darker border, and the cup is framed within a rectangular outline. The artist's signature, "Hester Bateman," is written in small letters at the bottom left corner.
title: Silver Bowl
